name: NexlifyDesk
author: NexlifyLabs Support

sections.description:
NexlifyDesk is a comprehensive, enterprise-grade support ticketing system for WordPress that transforms your website into a professional customer service hub. Built with scalability and efficiency in mind, it provides everything you need to deliver exceptional support experiences while maintaining complete control over your customer data.

Documentation: Full Documentation & Setup Guide

Key Features

Frontend Customer Experience
* Ticket Submission & Management: Clean, user-friendly interface for customers to submit tickets, view their history, and track progress
* Real-time Updates: AJAX-powered interface with live status updates and instant reply notifications
* File Attachments: Support for multiple file types with configurable size limits and security validation
* Responsive Design: Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

Advanced Admin Dashboard
* Centralized Ticket Management: Comprehensive admin interface with filtering, search, and bulk actions
* Real-time Statistics: Live dashboard with ticket counts, response times, and performance metrics
* Agent Assignment: Intelligent auto-assignment or manual assignment with load balancing
* Status Management: Five ticket statuses (Open, In Progress, Pending, Resolved, Closed) with automatic workflows

Agent Roles & Permissions System
* Custom Agent Positions: Create unlimited agent roles with granular permission control
* Capability Management: Fine-tune what each agent can do (view all tickets, assign tickets, manage categories, etc.)
* Agent Performance Tracking: Monitor response times, resolution rates, and workload distribution
* Orphaned Ticket Management: Automatic reassignment when agents are removed or deactivated

Professional Communication Tools
* Internal Notes: Private agent-to-agent communication within tickets (invisible to customers)
* Email Notifications: Fully customizable templates with dynamic placeholders for all scenarios
* Notification Control: Granular settings for when and how notifications are sent
* Professional Templates: Pre-designed email templates for new tickets, replies, status changes, and SLA breaches

Intelligent Automation
* Duplicate Detection: Advanced algorithms detect similar tickets and merge conversations automatically
* Auto-Assignment: Smart distribution of tickets to available agents based on workload
* SLA Monitoring: Automatic tracking and breach notifications to maintain service standards
* Auto-Closure: Resolved tickets automatically close after 48 hours of inactivity with system notifications

Categories & Organization
* Unlimited Categories: Organize tickets with custom categories and descriptions
* Priority Levels: Four priority levels (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) with visual indicators
* Search & Filtering: Advanced search across all ticket fields with multiple filter options
* Bulk Operations: Manage multiple tickets simultaneously

WooCommerce Integration
* Order History: Built-in order lookup for WooCommerce stores
* Customer Context: Access customer order information directly from tickets
* Order-based Duplicate Detection: Automatically link tickets to existing order-related conversations

Reporting & Analytics
* Performance Metrics: Comprehensive reporting on ticket volume, response times, and agent performance
* Visual Charts: Interactive charts showing ticket trends, priority distribution, and monthly statistics
* Recent Activity: Real-time feed of all support activities across your team

Developer & Advanced Features
* Template Override System: Customize any frontend template by copying to your theme
* Shortcode System: Flexible shortcodes with customizable attributes ([nexlifydesk_ticket_form] and [nexlifydesk_ticket_list])
* Data Management: Configurable data retention with optional purge functionality
* Rate Limiting: Built-in protection against spam and abuse
* Caching System: Optimized performance with intelligent cache management

Duplicate Ticket Detection

NexlifyDesk includes a sophisticated three-layer duplicate detection system to maintain clean, organized support queues:

1. Exact Subject Matching
– Detects identical subjects from the same user within the last 30 days
– Automatically adds new messages as replies to the existing conversation
– Prevents ticket fragmentation for ongoing issues

2. Order Number Pattern Recognition
– Intelligently recognizes order/invoice numbers in subjects and messages
– Patterns include: “Order #12345”, “Invoice ID: 67890”, “#ABC123”, etc.
– Links all order-related communications to a single ticket thread

3. Content Similarity Analysis
– Advanced keyword comparison between new tickets and recent submissions from the same user
– Configurable similarity threshold (default: 80%) for fine-tuned control
– Smart filtering of common stop words for accurate matching

User Experience
When a duplicate is detected, users receive clear notification that their message has been added to an existing conversation, maintaining context while preventing scattered tickets.

Administrative Control
– Enable/disable duplicate detection from NexlifyDesk > Settings
– Adjust sensitivity threshold to match your support workflow
– View duplicate detection stats in the reports dashboard

Usage

Shortcodes

[nexlifydesk_ticket_form] – Displays the ticket submission form
* show_title="no" – Hides the default “Submit a Ticket” title
* category="5" – Pre-select a specific category ID
* priority="high" – Pre-select priority level

[nexlifydesk_ticket_list] – Displays user’s ticket history
* show_title="no" – Hides the default title
* status="open" – Filter by specific status
* limit="10" – Limit number of tickets displayed

Admin Menu Structure

NexlifyDesk (Main Menu)
* All Tickets: Complete ticket management with advanced filtering and search
* Categories: Create and organize ticket categories with descriptions
* Settings: Configure all plugin options, automation rules, and integrations
* Reports: Performance analytics, charts, and team statistics
* Agent Positions: Define custom roles and assign capabilities to team members
* Order History: WooCommerce order lookup and customer information (requires WooCommerce)
* Email Templates: Customize all automated email notifications
* Support: Contact NexlifyLabs for assistance and feature requests

Ticket Statuses

The system uses five distinct statuses for comprehensive workflow management:

  • Open: New tickets awaiting initial response
  • In Progress: Actively being worked on by an agent
  • Pending: Waiting for customer response or external action
  • Resolved: Issue solved, awaiting customer confirmation
  • Closed: Completed tickets (auto-closed after 48 hours resolved, or manually closed)

Agent Capabilities

Create custom agent positions with these granular permissions:

  • View All Tickets: Access to organization-wide tickets vs. only assigned ones
  • Assign Tickets: Ability to assign tickets to other agents
  • Manage Categories: Create, edit, and organize ticket categories
  • View Reports: Access to analytics and performance reporting

Customization

NexlifyDesk offers extensive customization options for businesses of all sizes:

Settings Panel Configuration
* Email Notifications: Control when and how notifications are sent
* Default Values: Set default priority, category, and assignment rules
* File Upload Controls: Manage allowed file types, sizes, and security settings
* SLA Management: Configure response time targets and breach notifications
* Automation Rules: Set up auto-assignment, duplicate detection, and closure policies

Email Template Customization
Complete control over all automated emails with a rich set of placeholders:
* Dynamic content insertion with {ticket_id}, {user_name}, {subject}, etc.
* HTML email support with visual preview
* Separate templates for different notification types
* Multi-language support with translation files

Visual Customization
* CSS Override: Use your theme’s CSS to match your brand
* Template System: Copy plugin templates to your theme for structural changes
* Responsive Design: Built-in mobile optimization with customizable breakpoints

Advanced Integration
* WooCommerce: Automatic order context and customer history
* Multisite Support: Works seamlessly across WordPress networks
* Developer Hooks: Extensive action and filter hooks for custom functionality
* REST API Ready: Structured for future API integration

Performance & Security

Optimized Performance
* Intelligent caching system reduces database queries
* AJAX-powered interface for smooth user experience
* Optimized database schema with proper indexing
* Background processing for email notifications

Security Features
* Nonce verification for all forms and AJAX requests
* Proper data sanitization and validation
* File upload security with type and size validation
* Rate limiting to prevent spam and abuse
* Capability-based access control throughout

Data Management
* Configurable data retention policies
* Optional data purging for old tickets
* Database maintenance tools for administrators
* Full export capabilities for data portability

Support & Documentation

Getting Help
* Email Support: support@nexlifylabs.com
* Website: https://nexlifylabs.com
* Documentation: Comprehensive guides available on our website
* Community: WordPress.org support forums

Premium Support
Upgrade to NexlifyDesk Pro for priority email support, advanced features, and dedicated account management.

Feature Requests
We actively develop NexlifyDesk based on user feedback. Submit feature requests through our support channels.

Privacy & Data Protection

Data Storage
* All ticket data is stored in your WordPress database
* No information is transmitted to external servers
* Complete control over your customer data

Email Handling
* Notifications sent through your site’s configured mail system
* No third-party email services required
* Full compliance with privacy regulations

Data Portability
* Built-in export capabilities for all ticket data
* Standard WordPress data formats for easy migration
* GDPR-compliant data handling and deletion options

Security Measures
* Industry-standard encryption for sensitive data
* Regular security audits and updates
* WordPress security best practices throughout

For complete privacy policy details, visit: https://nexlifylabs.com/privacy-policy

Uninstall Process

Data Retention (Default)
By default, NexlifyDesk preserves all your valuable support data when uninstalled:
* All tickets and customer conversations
* Agent responses and internal notes
* File attachments and customer data
* Categories and configuration settings
* Performance analytics and reports

Complete Removal (Optional)
To permanently delete all plugin data during uninstall:
1. Go to NexlifyDesk > Settings
2. Uncheck “Keep all tickets and data when plugin is uninstalled”
3. Save settings before uninstalling

Warning: Complete removal permanently deletes ALL support history, customer data, and configurations. This action cannot be undone. Always backup your database before proceeding.

What Gets Removed During Complete Uninstall
* All support tickets and conversations
* Customer replies and agent responses
* File attachments and uploaded documents
* Ticket categories and custom settings
* Agent positions and permission configurations
* Email templates and notification settings
* All analytics data and performance reports
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin: Upload the nexlifydesk folder to /wp-content/plugins/ via FTP, or install directly through WordPress admin by uploading the ZIP file.

  2. Activate: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

  3. Initial Configuration: Navigate to NexlifyDesk > Settings to configure:

    • Email notification preferences
    • File upload limits and allowed types
    • Default ticket priority and category
    • SLA response time targets
    • Auto-assignment rules

  4. Create Frontend Pages: Set up user-facing pages:

    • Ticket Submission Page: Create a page and add [nexlifydesk_ticket_form]
    • Ticket History Page: Create another page and add [nexlifydesk_ticket_list]
    • Link these pages in NexlifyDesk > Settings for proper navigation

  5. Agent Setup (Optional): Configure your support team:

    • Create user accounts for support agents
    • Assign the “NexlifyDesk Agent” role
    • Define custom agent positions with specific capabilities
    • Set up auto-assignment rules
sections.faq:
How do I create a support ticket submission form?

Create a new WordPress page and add the shortcode [nexlifydesk_ticket_form]. You can customize it with optional attributes:
– show_title="no" – Hides the default form title
– The form includes fields for subject, message, category, priority, and file attachments

How can customers view their submitted tickets?

Create a page with the shortcode [nexlifydesk_ticket_list]. Logged-in users will see their tickets, while agents with appropriate permissions will see their assigned tickets. Optional attributes:
– show_title="no" – Hides the default page title

Can I customize the email notifications?

Yes, completely! Go to NexlifyDesk > Email Templates to customize all notification emails:
– New Ticket: Sent when a ticket is created
– New Reply: Sent when someone replies to a ticket
– Status Changed: Sent when ticket status is updated
– SLA Breach: Sent when response time targets are missed

Available placeholders include {ticket_id}, {subject}, {user_name}, {status}, {ticket_url}, and many more.

How do I set up support agents?

Basic Setup:
1. Go to Users > Add New and create user accounts for your support team
2. Assign them the “NexlifyDesk Agent” role

Advanced Setup:
1. Go to NexlifyDesk > Agent Positions to create custom roles
2. Define specific capabilities for each position (e.g., “Level 1 Support”, “Technical Lead”)
3. Assign agents to positions via their user profiles
4. Configure auto-assignment rules in Settings

What file types can be attached to tickets?

By default: JPG, PNG, PDF, and common document types. You can customize:
– Allowed file extensions: Modify the list in NexlifyDesk > Settings
– Maximum file size: Set size limits per attachment
– Security: All uploads are validated and stored securely

How does the SLA monitoring work?

Set your target response time in NexlifyDesk > Settings (in hours). The system:
– Automatically tracks when tickets approach or exceed SLA targets
– Sends breach notifications to administrators and assigned agents
– Displays SLA status in the admin dashboard
– Includes SLA metrics in performance reports

Can I integrate with WooCommerce?

Yes! NexlifyDesk includes built-in WooCommerce integration:
– Order History page: Look up customer orders directly from the admin
– Order-based duplicate detection: Links tickets mentioning order numbers
– Customer context: View order information when handling support requests

How does automatic ticket assignment work?

The smart assignment system:
1. Finds available agents: Checks users with the NexlifyDesk Agent role
2. Balances workload: Assigns to the agent with the fewest open tickets
3. Fallback options: Can assign to administrators if no agents are available
4. Handles changes: Automatically reassigns orphaned tickets when agents are removed

What happens to closed tickets?

  • Manual closure: Agents can close tickets at any time
  • Automatic closure: Resolved tickets automatically close after 48 hours of inactivity
  • Reopening: Closed tickets can be reopened by administrators
  • Customer interaction: Customers cannot reply to closed tickets and are prompted to create new ones

Is my data safe when uninstalling?

By default, YES! NexlifyDesk preserves all data (tickets, replies, attachments, customer information) even after plugin deletion. You can change this behavior in NexlifyDesk > Settings if you prefer to remove all data during uninstall.

How do internal notes work?

Internal notes are private messages between support team members:
– Only visible to agents and administrators
– Never sent to customers via email
– Perfect for sharing context, escalation notes, or internal updates
– Added via the “Add Internal Note” tab in the admin ticket view

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, several ways:
– CSS Styling: Override the plugin’s CSS in your theme
– Template System: Copy template files to your theme for structural changes
– Settings Panel: Customize colors, labels, and behavior options
– Email Templates: Full control over all notification email content and styling
